description: This file defines a singleton object 'ThemeManager' which manages application theme settings, allowing to set, get, and apply saved themes using shared preferences and Android's AppCompatDelegate.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Enum class representing possible themes: LIGHT, DARK, SYSTEM

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the application's theme and saves the preference

methods.name: applySavedTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the saved theme from preferences and applies it
